meta.source: Presentation template defaults. Replace with values from the approved client spec (spec/client-spec.md).

color.note: Themes are the concepts. The brand primitives never change between them; semantic tokens (surface, text, accent-text, focus-ring...) carry each concept's look. Text on the accent is always on-accent.

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: Master brand accent from the client spec. Fills for primary buttons, CTA bands, key figures and active states. Text on it is always on-accent (ink here, 6.06:1). White on this default measures 2.96:1 and fails WCAG AA, so it never carries white text.

tokens.name: logo-accent
tokens.usage: Accent inside the logo artwork. Asset-only: never a UI fill or text color. When it differs from brand-accent, the client confirms one master value.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Secondary highlight from the logo or brand. Cinematic focus ring (12.8:1 on surface) and small highlights on dark grounds only. Never text or a fill on light grounds, where it falls under 1.5:1.

tokens.name: logo-detail
tokens.usage: Detail color inside the logo artwork. Asset-only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand near-black. Body text on every light surface, text on brand-accent, and the Cinematic raised surface.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: Wordmark color inside the logo artwork. Asset-only; UI black is ink.

tokens.name: accent-100
tokens.usage: Tag and selected-row wash on light surfaces; ink text on it (15.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-200
tokens.usage: Hover wash for list rows on light surfaces; ink text on it.

tokens.name: accent-400
tokens.usage: Link hover on dark surfaces (9.2:1 on neutral-950).

tokens.name: accent-500
tokens.usage: Alias of brand-accent so the ramp reads in order.

tokens.name: accent-600
tokens.usage: Display figures 24px and larger on light surfaces (3.6:1 on neutral-50). Never body text.

tokens.name: accent-700
tokens.usage: Accent text on light surfaces: 5.71:1 on neutral-0, 5.28:1 on neutral-50, 4.96:1 on neutral-100, 4.57:1 on neutral-150.

tokens.name: accent-800
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for accent text on light surfaces (6.1:1 on neutral-100).

tokens.name: neutral-0
tokens.usage: Raised surface in Engineered and Editorial: cards, forms, spec plates. Near-white; never pure #fff.

tokens.name: neutral-25
tokens.usage: Editorial page background.

tokens.name: neutral-50
tokens.usage: Engineered page background; body text in Cinematic (17.4:1 on neutral-950).

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Sunken bands on the light concepts (FAQ, footer strip, alternating sections).

tokens.name: neutral-150
tokens.usage: Hover fill for quiet buttons and rows on the light concepts.

tokens.name: neutral-200
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines on light surfaces. Not for control borders (use neutral-500).

tokens.name: neutral-300
tokens.usage: Muted text over photography, always on scrim (6.1:1 over an 82% scrim on a white sky).

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: Muted text on Cinematic surfaces (7.1:1 on neutral-950, 6.7:1 on neutral-900).

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Form control borders in every concept: 3.2:1 or better on every surface they sit on, hover fills included.

tokens.name: neutral-600
tokens.usage: Muted text on light surfaces (5.7:1 on neutral-50, 5.4:1 on neutral-100).

tokens.name: neutral-700
tokens.usage: Strong rules on Cinematic surfaces.

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines on Cinematic surfaces.

tokens.name: neutral-850
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows and quiet buttons in Cinematic.

tokens.name: neutral-900
tokens.usage: Alias of ink; the Cinematic raised surface.

tokens.name: neutral-950
tokens.usage: Cinematic page background.

tokens.name: neutral-1000
tokens.usage: Cinematic sunken bands and footer. Kinetic page surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Cinematic neutral-950; Engineered neutral-50; Editorial neutral-25; Kinetic neutral-1000, the deepest black, so glass panels and the accent light read.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, forms, spec plates, the header once scrolled. Carries text, text-muted and accent-text. Kinetic: the opaque equivalent of its glass panels (6% white over the surface), used for contrast checks.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternating bands (FAQ, footer strip). Carries text, text-muted and accent-text (4.96:1 minimum). Kinetic lifts instead of sinking (neutral-950): its surface is already the darkest step.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for quiet buttons, menu rows and job rows.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Rare inverted blocks such as tooltips; pages never flip to it section by section. Text on it is text-inverse.

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: Accent color field: Editorial values band, CTA bands. Text on it is on-accent; focus rings on it use focus-ring-on-accent.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (15:1 or better in every theme).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (5.3:1 minimum).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: text-on-photo
tokens.usage: Headlines and body over photography, always on scrim (10.3:1 even over a white sky).

tokens.name: text-on-photo-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text over photography, always on scrim (6.1:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active nav marker, key figures on dark. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill; ink text on it holds 7.2:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, accent-hover and surface-accent (6.06:1). Never white.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent text and links on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken: 6.0:1 or better in Cinematic, 4.96:1 or better on the light concepts.

tokens.name: accent-text-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state for accent-text links.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Rules that organize data: Engineered spec plates, table heads, the footer top rule.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and quiet buttons: 3.2:1 or better on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring 3px outside the control, 12:1 or better on every surface it lands on.

tokens.name: focus-ring-on-accent
tokens.usage: Focus ring for controls sitting on an accent field (6.06:1 on brand-accent).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, invalid field borders and the error-summary rule: 7.3:1 on neutral-900 in Cinematic, 5.6:1 or better on the light surfaces. Always paired with an icon and the word Error.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Form success and confirmations: 9.0:1 in Cinematic, 5.3:1 or better on light surfaces. Blue, so it never relies on red versus green. Always paired with an icon.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Photo overlay behind text: the text side of every hero gradient and caption plate.

tokens.name: scrim-soft
tokens.usage: Photo toning where no text sits on the image.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Desktop sizes; pages scale them fluidly (see README). Concepts change weight, case and tracking, never the family.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline only; two lines at most.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Inner page headers and the Cinematic services index.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Sub-sections, service names on the Services page.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Small titles: FAQ questions, job titles, form sections.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: One plain line on the work, the place and the outcome.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs under a hero or section title; 20 words or fewer in a hero.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: Body copy in short sentences, one idea each, written the way the client talks.
styles.usage: Default body copy; keep lines under 70 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Footer, captions, helper text under fields.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Uppercase meta labels: tags, the one eyebrow a page may carry per three sections.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Key figures and the phone number in CTA bands; set with tabular figures.

groups.name: Wide accent
groups.note: Wide label face for the Engineered and Kinetic concepts. Labels only; swap or drop per the client spec.

styles.name: wide-label
styles.usage: Engineered spec-plate labels and figure captions; uppercase, never body text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related lines: title and meta in a job row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; padding inside tags and small panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; gap in card grids.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablet; Engineered section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (Cinematic).

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (Editorial and Kinetic, the most open concepts).

radius.note: Each concept locks one corner system: Cinematic is all-sharp, Engineered is 2px everywhere, Editorial is 16px cards and media with pill buttons and tags and 8px fields, Kinetic is 32px glass shells with 24px cores, pill actions and 16px fields.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cinematic: every surface, control and image.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Engineered: every surface, control and image.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Editorial form fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Editorial cards and media.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Editorial buttons and tags.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Kinetic inner cores and media: the panel radius minus the 8px shell inset, so curves stay concentric.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Kinetic outer shells: cards, plates, the CTA band and the veil menu.

shadow.note: Cinematic and Engineered separate surfaces with borders, not shadows. Editorial uses one soft, ink-tinted shadow. Kinetic uses a deep, diffuse shadow plus a 1px inner highlight, the glass panel's top edge.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and media on the page. Kinetic adds the inner highlight of its glass panels here.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The mobile nav drawer and the sticky header once scrolled.

layout.note: Container and header sizes shared by every concept.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Widest content column.

tokens.name: container-text
tokens.usage: Long-form text column, about 68 characters of body-md.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page gutter at 1024px and up.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Page gutter under 768px.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Desktop header height.

tokens.name: header-height-mobile
tokens.usage: Header height under 1024px.

breakpoint.note: Min-width breakpoints; mirror them in Oxygen's breakpoint settings.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones: two-up tags, inline form rows.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet: multi-column sections begin.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop nav replaces the drawer.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Full container width.

zIndex.note: The only layers the site uses.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky site header.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Mobile nav drawer and its backdrop.

tokens.name: z-skip
tokens.usage: Skip link when focused.
